queries.title: Homelessness budget, Encampment reports and emergency shelter beds, by fiscal year
queries.method: Three series for the City of San Diego per fiscal year (1 July to 30 June, named by the year it ends). Budget: the sum of amount in Budget fixture where budget_cycle is adopted, account_number begins with 5 (the City's expense accounts) and dept_name contains "homeless"; a two-digit report_fy is read as 2000 plus that number. A year with no such department has no amount, which is not an amount of zero, and rows with no budget_cycle are not counted as adopted. Reports: rows whose service_name is Encampment in Open reports fixture and the closed-reports tables for 2023 to 2026, counted once per service_request_id and filing time, by the fiscal year of date_requested. The publisher files a closed report under the year it was closed, so a fiscal year is counted only when the open file and every closed file from the calendar year it began through 2026 are imported, each retrieved at least a day after its year ended or no earlier than the open copy. Here that is FY 2024 to FY 2026; other years are not counted. Beds: the sum of Year_Round_Beds, and of Total_Beds, over the rows of Shelter inventory fixture whose City is San Diego, per Year. The inventory is a count made on one night each January, so the January 2025 count is set beside fiscal year 2025, seven months into it. Years before 2018 are left out because the year-round and seasonal columns were filled differently then. A fiscal year is compared when all three series are present and at least 30 Encampment reports were filed in it. A lead is raised with at least 2 such years and one series differing by 10% or more between the first and the latest; 10% is a fixed yardstick, not a statistical test. The series come from three publishers and nothing here shows why any of them moved.
queries.sql:
WITH budget_lines AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)) AS department, TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS report_fy, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
  CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AS expense, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR))), 'homeless'), FALSE) AS named
 FROM "analysis_budget"
 WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("budget_cycle" AS VARCHAR))) = 'adopted'
), budget_years AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN report_fy BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + report_fy ELSE report_fy END AS fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS adopted_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE named) AS department_rows,
  SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE named AND expense) AS adopted_expense, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE named AND expense AND amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_amounts,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT department, '; ') FILTER (WHERE named) AS departments
 FROM budget_lines WHERE report_fy IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
), report_rows AS (
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)) AS report_id, TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS filed_at
 FROM "analysis_open" WHERE TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)) = 'Encampment'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)) AS report_id, TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS filed_at
 FROM "analysis_closed_2026" WHERE TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)) = 'Encampment'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)) AS report_id, TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS filed_at
 FROM "analysis_closed_2025" WHERE TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)) = 'Encampment'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)) AS report_id, TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS filed_at
 FROM "analysis_closed_2024" WHERE TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)) = 'Encampment'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT TRIM(CAST("service_request_id" AS VARCHAR)) AS report_id, TRY_CAST(CAST("date_requested" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP) AS filed_at
 FROM "analysis_closed_2023" WHERE TRIM(CAST("service_name" AS VARCHAR)) = 'Encampment'
), reports AS (SELECT DISTINCT report_id, filed_at FROM report_rows
), report_years AS (
 SELECT YEAR(filed_at) + CAST(MONTH(filed_at) >= 7 AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS encampment_reports FROM reports WHERE filed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
), report_span AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE filed_at IS NULL) AS undated_reports FROM reports
), bed_years AS (
 SELECT TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS shelter_projects, SUM(TRY_CAST("year_round_beds" AS DOUBLE)) AS year_round_beds, SUM(TRY_CAST("total_beds" AS DOUBLE)) AS total_beds,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRY_CAST("year_round_beds" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) AS projects_without_year_round, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRY_CAST("total_beds" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) AS projects_without_total
 FROM "analysis_shelter" WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("city" AS VARCHAR))) = 'san diego' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT bed_years.fiscal_year, adopted_rows, department_rows, departments, adopted_expense, unreadable_amounts,
 CASE WHEN bed_years.fiscal_year IN (2024, 2025, 2026) THEN COALESCE(encampment_reports, 0) END AS encampment_reports, undated_reports,
 shelter_projects, year_round_beds, total_beds, projects_without_year_round, projects_without_total
FROM bed_years LEFT JOIN budget_years ON budget_years.fiscal_year = bed_years.fiscal_year
 LEFT JOIN report_years ON report_years.fiscal_year = bed_years.fiscal_year CROSS JOIN report_span
WHERE bed_years.fiscal_year >= 2018 ORDER BY bed_years.fiscal_year
